name: Phantom-X
author: Sanctuary Mods (after Novaprim3, Duck_42, mead, SpikeyNoob and Fichom's Phantom-X for Forged Alliance)
description: Supreme Commander's Phantom-X. Everyone starts allied; a few minutes in, some players secretly become phantoms, fed a share of everyone else's income. Phantoms win by being the last one standing, innocents by killing every phantom. Paladins hunt them with a smaller bonus, which phantoms can pay to take away. Phantoms are revealed at set times. Break and offer alliances, mark paladins, vote and volunteer on the Phantom-X panel. Best with three or more players.

options.label: Number of phantoms
options.description: With a vote, nobody voting means a third of the players (rounded up). There's always at least one innocent.

options.label: Phantoms chosen at (minutes)
options.description: Until then everyone is allied and nobody has a role. The vote opens two minutes before, volunteering one minute before.

options.label: Picking phantoms
options.description: Volunteers get six tickets in the draw to everyone else's one. Balancing (two phantoms only) picks the pair whose spending best matches the innocents'.

options.label: Phantom bonus (%)
options.description: Scales every phantom and paladin bonus. At 100% one phantom gets 20-28% of the innocents' combined income, depending on how many innocents it's still allied with.

options.label: Paladins per phantom
options.description: Paladins are innocents with a share of the phantom bonus. Fractions round down.

options.label: Paladin marks
options.description: Shared out between the phantoms. A mark costs alloys, more as the match goes on, and stops a paladin's bonus.

options.label: First reveal (minutes, 0 = never)
options.description: Counted from when the phantoms are chosen.

options.label: Second reveal
options.description: After the first. Just after is 12 seconds; with Never, nobody else is revealed.

options.label: Third reveal
options.description: After the second, the same way.

options.label: Reveal a player's role when they die
options.description: Also shows how many phantoms and innocents are left.
